objectives.title: The Last Homely House
objectives.description: Imladris is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Golden Wood
objectives.description: Caras Galadhon is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Woodland Realm
objectives.description: Thranduil's Halls is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Elven Alliance
objectives.description: Your own realm holds 6 or more PCs when the Age ends.

milestones.title: The Tower Hills
milestones.story: The white towers watch the sea, and no one keeps them. A grey pilgrim climbs to Elostirion to light a beacon there again.
milestones.how: You stand at Elostirion. Play the Elostirion card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: Trade of the Shipwrights
milestones.story: Shipwrights need timber and iron, and a wizard's road is paid in gold. Sell what the hills give you.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Road to the Havens
milestones.story: West lies Mithlond, where the grey ships wait, and Círdan who has watched three Ages from his quays.
milestones.how: Walk west from the Tower Hills to the Grey Havens.

milestones.title: The Shipwright
milestones.story: Círdan gave you the Red Ring long ago. Ask him now for his people.
milestones.how: Go to The Grey Havens and play A Friend or Three there. Win Cirdan over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Wardens of Lindon
milestones.story: Lindon's spears have rusted in long peace. Call the wardens to arms.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Elven Scouts or Archers).

milestones.title: Wolves on the Tower Hills
milestones.story: On the way back east, wolves howl on the Tower Hills: a dark captain holds the slope below Elostirion.
milestones.how: Belceborg's wolves hold the hex beside Elostirion. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Belceborg.

milestones.title: The Quiet Shire
milestones.story: East of the hills the Shire sleeps, and a hobbit there keeps a ring he should not.
milestones.how: Walk east into the Shire, to Hobbiton.

milestones.title: The Road East
milestones.story: Past Bree and Weathertop the road runs into the wild Angle, where Elrond's riders keep watch.
milestones.how: Follow the East Road to the Angle, between the rivers.

milestones.title: The Last Homely House
milestones.story: Hidden in its valley, Rivendell waits. Its door opens only to those who know the way.
milestones.how: Go on to Imladris, the hidden valley north of the Angle.

milestones.title: The Council
milestones.story: In the Last Homely House the wise sit long over their wine. Win Elrond, and all of Rivendell rides with you.
milestones.how: Go to Imladris and play A Friend or Three there. Win Elrond over and their whole realm joins you.

objectives.title: Into the Fire
objectives.description: Any of your characters reaches Mount Doom. Decisive: wins the war at once.

objectives.title: The Mark Stands
objectives.description: Edoras is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Lake-town
objectives.description: Esgaroth is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The White City Stands
objectives.description: Minas Tirith is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Free North
objectives.description: Your own realm holds 8 or more PCs when the Age ends.

milestones.title: Beorn's House
milestones.story: Beorn's hall stands among the oaks, open to friends and death to foes. Make it your shelter in the Vale.
milestones.how: You stand at BeornHouse. Play the BeornHouse card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: Honey and Mead
milestones.story: Honey, mead and fleeces go down the river to market. A friend of the Beornings may share the profit.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Carrock
milestones.story: The Carrock rises from the river like a stair for giants. From its top the whole Vale lies open.
milestones.how: Walk west to the Carrock, the rock in the Anduin.

milestones.title: The Éothéod
milestones.story: North of the Carrock the horse-folk of Maethelburg keep their herds. Their lord Ingomer is proud, but no friend of wargs.
milestones.how: Go to Maethelburg and play A Friend or Three there. Win Ingomer over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Riders of the Vales
milestones.story: Horsemen of the Vale wait for a captain. Give them one.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Light Cavalry or Men At Arms).

milestones.title: Wargs in the Vale
milestones.story: Wargs gather south of Beorn's House, and their riders laugh at the bees.
milestones.how: Bugrug's wargs hold the ground two hexes south of Beorn's House. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Bugrug.

milestones.title: The Woodmen
milestones.story: The Woodmen guard the eaves of Mirkwood and trust few. Earn the trust of their town.
milestones.how: Go to Woodmen town and play A Friend or Three there. Win Beoraborn over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: The Long Lake
milestones.story: East through the forest road, the lake-town stands on its stilts, rebuilt after the dragon's fall.
milestones.how: Cross Mirkwood eastward to Esgaroth on the Long Lake.

milestones.title: The King in Dale
milestones.story: Bard the Bowman rules Dale and the lake. His black arrow brought down a dragon; it can serve again.
milestones.how: Go to Esgaroth and play A Friend or Three there. Win Bard over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: The Heir of Dale
milestones.story: In Dale, Bard's heir keeps the old songs. With Bain beside you, the North stands as one.
milestones.how: Go to Dale, where Bain lives, and play the Bain card there: they join you.

objectives.title: The Shire Endures
objectives.description: You hold Hobbiton when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Road Kept Open
objectives.description: Bree is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.description: Imladris is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

milestones.title: Bag End
milestones.story: A wizard's cart rolls into Hobbiton, and the hobbits peer from their round doors. Make Bag End your home in the Shire.
milestones.how: You stand at Hobbiton. Play the Hobbiton card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: Pipe-weed Markets
milestones.story: Pipe-weed from the Southfarthing fetches good silver at market. Bring your goods.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Tooks
milestones.story: The Tooks love adventure more than is proper. Seek young Pippin at Michel Delving, a short walk west.
milestones.how: Go to Michel Delving and play A Friend or Three there. Win Pippin over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Bounders and Shirriffs
milestones.story: Bounders walk the borders and Shirriffs keep the peace. Muster them into something sharper.
milestones.how: You are no captain: have a Took commander play an army card (Bounders or Hobbit Archers) at one of your PCs.

milestones.title: Wolves in the Shire
milestones.story: Wolves have crossed the Brandywine and lurk by Hobbiton. The Shire has not fought since the Greenfields.
milestones.how: Gorbag's wolves hold the hex beside Hobbiton. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Gorbag.

milestones.title: Through the Marish
milestones.story: East through the Marish the lanes wind to Stock and the Brandywine ferry.
milestones.how: Walk east from Hobbiton to Stock.

milestones.title: The Old Forest
milestones.story: Beyond Buckland the trees are old and awake. Somewhere among them a strange fellow sings.
milestones.how: Cross the Brandywine and go into the Old Forest.

milestones.title: The Prancing Pony
milestones.story: At Bree the Prancing Pony hears every rumour on the road. Go and listen.
milestones.how: Leave the Forest by the East Road and go on to Bree.

milestones.title: Strider
milestones.story: A grim Ranger sits in a corner of the inn, his hood drawn. Win Strider, and the Dúnedain follow.
milestones.how: Go to Bree and play A Friend or Three there. Win Aragorn over and their whole realm joins you.

objectives.title: Into the Fire

objectives.title: The Lonely Mountain
objectives.description: You hold Erebor (Lost) when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Iron Hills Stand
objectives.description: Azanulimbar-Dum is held by the Free Peoples when the Age ends.

objectives.title: The Seven Houses
objectives.description: Your own realm holds 6 or more PCs when the Age ends.

milestones.title: Thorin's Halls
milestones.story: Thorin's Halls are a poor exile's home, but they are dwarf-built and strong. Make them your seat.
milestones.how: You stand at ThorinHall. Play the ThorinHall card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: Oakenshield
milestones.story: Thorin Oakenshield broods on a lost mountain and a dragon's hoard. He will listen to a wizard.
milestones.how: Go to ThorinHall, where Thorin lives, and play the Thorin card there: they join you.

milestones.title: The Dwarf-road Trade
milestones.story: Dwarf-smiths sell iron and steel to Men along the road. Fill your purse in that trade.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: Axes of the Blue Mountains
milestones.story: Axes hang idle on the walls of the Blue Mountains. Call the dwarves to march.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Dwarven Explorers or Men At Arms).

milestones.title: Goblins in the Halls
milestones.story: Goblins creep out of the deep roads by Thorin's Halls. Show them dwarf-steel.
milestones.how: Gorbag's cave goblins hold the hex beside Thorin's Halls. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Gorbag.

milestones.title: The Ruins of Belegost
milestones.story: South along the mountains, ruined Belegost sleeps where the dwarves of old once delved.
milestones.how: Walk south from Thorin's Halls to Belegost.

milestones.title: The Lords of Belegost
milestones.story: Glóin keeps what is left of Belegost and remembers its glory. Win him, and the Blue Mountains are yours.
milestones.how: Go to Belegost and play A Friend or Three there. Win Gloin over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Telenaug
milestones.story: Further south the road climbs to Telenaug, where Dwalin keeps the forge-fires lit.
milestones.how: Go on south to Telenaug.

milestones.title: Nogrod Remembered
milestones.story: At the southern end of the Blue Mountains lies Nogrod, the other great hall of old. Reach it, and the dwarf-road is yours end to end.
milestones.how: Go to Noegrod, at the southern end of the mountains.

milestones.title: The Ruined Bridge
milestones.story: Osgiliath lies broken across the Anduin, the last crossing against Mordor. Hold it.
milestones.how: You stand at Osgiliath. Play the Osgiliath card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: The Guard of the Bridge
milestones.story: Boromir's men hold the western bank, few and weary. Raise a host to stand with them.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Swordmen or Archers).

milestones.title: Orcs at the Bridge
milestones.story: Orcs hold the ruins by the river and mock the fallen city. Break them.
milestones.how: Gorbag's orcs hold the hex beside Osgiliath. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Gorbag.

milestones.title: The Harlond Markets
milestones.story: The Harlond's quays still unload grain and steel for the city. Gondor needs every coin.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Steward of Gondor
milestones.story: Denethor sits in his tower, proud and grieving, two hexes west. Win the Steward, and Minas Tirith is yours to lead.
milestones.how: Go to Minas Tirith and play A Friend or Three there. Win Denethor over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: The River Isle
milestones.story: North up the Anduin, Cair Andros guards the river's last crossing. Faramir's rangers watch from there.
milestones.how: Ride north from Minas Tirith to Cair Andros.

milestones.title: The Wild Men
milestones.story: In the Drúadan Forest, west of the river, the Woses know hidden ways. Ghân-buri-Ghân will guide riders who come in peace.
milestones.how: Go to Druadan Forest and play A Friend or Three there. Win GhanBuriGhan over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Ride to Edoras
milestones.story: Rohan's king must be roused. Ride north-west across the Eastfold to Edoras.
milestones.how: Ride on north-west to Edoras, the Golden Hall.

milestones.title: Théoden Rides
milestones.story: Théoden stands in the Golden Hall under a poisoned word. Help him cast it off and the Rohirrim ride.
milestones.how: Go to Edoras and play A Friend or Three there. Win Theoden over and their whole realm joins you.

objectives.description: Hold Edoras and Minas Tirith at the same time. Decisive: wins the war at once.

objectives.title: Lord of the Mark

milestones.title: The Tower of Orthanc
milestones.story: Orthanc's black tower is yours by the Steward's gift. Take up its keys.
milestones.how: You stand at Orthanc. Play the Orthanc card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: The Wealth of Isengard
milestones.story: Isengard's wealth lies in its forges and granaries. Turn them into gold.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Dunland Hills
milestones.story: Just west of the tower the Dunland hills begin, and their bitter folk watch the horse-lords' fields.
milestones.how: Walk west from Orthanc to Treforn.

milestones.title: The Dunlendings
milestones.story: The Dunlendings hate the horse-lords. A sweet voice at Larach Duhnnan can turn that hatred to use.
milestones.how: Go to Larach Duhnnan and play A Friend or Three there. Win Waulfa over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: The Wardens of the Tower
milestones.story: Dunland's warriors gather for the White Wizard. Arm them.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Spearmen or Men At Arms).

milestones.title: The Westfold
milestones.story: South of the hills lie the Westfold's farms, the edge of Rohan. Walk them and be seen as a friend.
milestones.how: Lead your host south-east to the Westfold.

milestones.title: The Voice of Saruman
milestones.story: Théoden is old and tired. Speak to him gently at Edoras, and Rohan becomes your shield.
milestones.how: Go to Edoras and play A Friend or Three there. Win Theoden over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Ost-in-Edhil
milestones.story: Ost-in-Edhil lies in ruins, where the Elven-smiths once forged the Rings. Make it your seat and your forge.
milestones.how: You stand at Ost-in-Edhil. Play the Ost-in-Edhil card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: Rings for Sale
milestones.story: Trinkets of Eregion's craft fetch high prices from greedy hands. Sell your wonders.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Swanfleet
milestones.story: North-west, the marshes of the Swanfleet hide old Elven roads. Your servants hold a camp there.
milestones.how: Walk north-west from Ost-in-Edhil to Nin-in-eilph.

milestones.title: The Dunlendings
milestones.story: South of the marshes the Dunlendings would follow anyone who promises them vengeance. Promise it at Larach Duhnnan.
milestones.how: Go to Larach Duhnnan and play A Friend or Three there. Win Waulfa over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Hosts of Many Colours
milestones.story: White light breaks into many colours. Raise a host as strange as your new robes.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Spearmen or Men At Arms).

milestones.title: The Road to the Tower
milestones.story: South-east lies Treforn, at the edge of the hills, one march from Isengard.
milestones.how: Lead the host south-east to Treforn.

milestones.title: The Tower Reclaimed
milestones.story: Orthanc stands over the circle of Isengard. Walk in as its master, wearing every colour.
milestones.how: Go on to Orthanc.

milestones.title: The Tower of Orthanc
milestones.story: Orthanc stands over the circle of Isengard, and the trees are already falling. Take its keys.
milestones.how: You stand at Orthanc. Play the Orthanc card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: The Furnaces' Hunger
milestones.story: The furnaces eat timber and iron day and night. Buy and sell what they need.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The First of the Uruk-hai
milestones.story: In the pits by Fangorn's edge a new breed has woken. Lurtz is the first of the Uruk-hai; bind him to you.
milestones.how: Go to FangornSCamp, where Lurtz lives, and play the Lurtz card there: they join you.

milestones.title: The Furnaces Burn
milestones.story: The hammers ring at Fangorn's camp. Arm the first host.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Spearmen or Men At Arms).

milestones.title: Spies in the Westfold
milestones.story: South-west, the Westfold's farms lie open. Your spies have counted every one.
milestones.how: March the host south-west to the Westfold.

milestones.title: The Deeping Wall
milestones.story: At the end of the Westfold, Helm's Deep shelters Rohan's people. Bring your host to its walls.
milestones.how: Go on to Helm's Deep.

milestones.title: The Uruk-hai March
milestones.story: Ten thousand Uruk-hai wait for the word. Raise one more host and let them march on Rohan.
milestones.how: Raise one more army: a commander at one of your PCs plays an army card.

milestones.title: The Green Dragon
milestones.story: Bywater's Green Dragon is a fine inn for a fallen wizard. Make it your headquarters.
milestones.how: You stand at Bywater. Play the Bywater card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: Gatherers and Sharers
milestones.story: Gatherers take, and sharers keep. Fill the purse.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Chief
milestones.story: Lotho calls himself the Chief and fills the Lockholes with hobbits who won't share. Make him your creature.
milestones.how: Go to The Lockholes and play A Friend or Three there. Win Lotho Sackville-Baggins over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Ruffians
milestones.story: Ruffians come up the Greenway looking for work. Give it to them.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Men At Arms or Spearmen).

milestones.title: Gathering Along the Marish
milestones.story: East through the Marish lie farms that haven't shared yet.
milestones.how: March east to Stock.

milestones.title: A Squint-eyed Friend
milestones.story: In Bree, Bill Ferny would sell his own mother. He knows every road south.
milestones.how: Go to Bree, where Bill Ferny lives, and play the Bill Ferny card there: they join you.

milestones.title: The Greenway South
milestones.story: The Greenway runs south past ruined Tharbad toward Dunland and old friends.
milestones.how: Go south along the Greenway to Tharbad.

milestones.title: Old Friends in Dunland
milestones.story: The Dunlendings remember who paid them. Win Waulfa at Larach Duhnnan, and the ruffians have an army behind them.
milestones.how: Go to Larach Duhnnan and play A Friend or Three there. Win Waulfa over and their whole realm joins you.

objectives.description: Minas Tirith is held by the Dark Servants. Decisive: wins the war at once.

objectives.title: Osgiliath Burns
objectives.description: Osgiliath is held by the Dark Servants when the Age ends.

objectives.description: You hold Barad-dur when the Age ends.

milestones.title: The Dark Tower
milestones.story: The Dark Tower rises again over Gorgoroth. Take your throne.
milestones.how: You stand at Barad-dur. Play the Barad-dur card here and it becomes your seat.

milestones.title: The Tribute of Nurn
milestones.story: The slave-fields of Nurn send their tribute north. Collect it.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Lieutenant
milestones.story: Your Mouth speaks with your will. Raise the Lieutenant of Barad-dûr to your side.
milestones.how: Go to Barad-dur, where Mouth of Sauron lives, and play the Mouth of Sauron card there: they join you.

milestones.title: The Fire Mountain
milestones.story: West of the tower, Orodruin smokes. Its fires remember the Ring.
milestones.how: Walk west to Mount Doom.

milestones.title: Ren the Unclean
milestones.story: At Barad Ungol, Ren the Unclean waits for his master's call. Give it.
milestones.how: Go to Barad Ungol and play A Friend or Three there. Win Ren the Unclean over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: The Black Host
milestones.story: The Black Host gathers in the vales. Arm it.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Men At Arms or Spearmen).

milestones.title: The Witch-king
milestones.story: Minas Morgul glows pale over its vale. The Witch-king waits there for the word.
milestones.how: Go to Minas Morgul and play A Friend or Three there. Win Murazor over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: Durthang
milestones.story: North, Durthang watches the passes. Bend its captain to your will.
milestones.how: Go to Durthang and play A Friend or Three there. Win Hoarmurath over and their whole realm joins you.

milestones.title: The Rangers of Ithilien
milestones.story: Faramir's rangers creep through the hills west of Durthang and ambush your roads.
milestones.how: Faramir's rangers hold the hills near the Morannon. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Faramir.

milestones.title: The Black Gate
milestones.story: The Black Gate stands at the head of the plain. Bring your host to it, and the West will tremble.
milestones.how: Take your host to the Morannon.

objectives.description: Havens of Umbar is held by the Dark Servants when the Age ends.

milestones.title: The Gifts of Annatar
milestones.story: Adûnaphel rules at Lugarlur, and she remembers Annatar, the Lord of Gifts. Win her back.
milestones.how: You stand at Lugarlur, Adûnaphel's seat. Play A Friend or Three here: win her over and her realm joins you.

milestones.title: Gifts Bought and Sold
milestones.story: Gifts are bought and sold. A fair face makes for good trade.
milestones.how: Gather 6 more gold. Play a Sell card at any of your PCs, or let your PCs' dues fill the purse turn by turn.

milestones.title: The Black Númenóreans
milestones.story: The Black Númenóreans of the coast are proud and cruel. Raise them.
milestones.how: With a commander at one of your PCs, play an army card (Men At Arms or Spearmen).

milestones.title: The Road to Near Harad
milestones.story: North-west the road leaves the desert for Near Harad's towns, rich and quarrelsome.
milestones.how: March north-west to Kas Shafra.

milestones.title: The Lords of Kas Shadoul
milestones.story: Haruth Rammam rules Kas Shadoul and sells his spears to the highest bidder. See what he asks.
milestones.how: Go on west to Kas Shadoul.

milestones.title: Gondor's Watch
milestones.story: Near Umbar, Thorondir's soldiers keep Gondor's watch on the coast. Break it.
milestones.how: Thorondir's soldiers hold the coast north of Umbar. March your army onto them and play Attack: break their army or slay Thorondir.

milestones.title: The Corsairs

milestones.title: The Shadow Returns
milestones.story: Dol Guldur waits on its hill in Mirkwood. Khamûl keeps it for you; come home.
milestones.how: Go to Dol Guldur and play A Friend or Three there. Win Khamul over and their whole realm joins you.
